title: feat(plugin-auth): with single sign-on configured, a signed-out visit can go straight to the identity provider and back, with a configurable local sign-in path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33183

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

> **Owes a contract review at TIER_DEFAULT** (widening; `Metadata-protocol: added`) from the new review agent. Seat reviews are paused, so this draft is not to land before that review.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：配置了单点登录的部署可以打开「直达登录」：未登录访问 Console 登录页时，直接跳到身份提供方，登录后回到原来要去的页面；本地密码登录入口可设为隐藏（`/login?local=1` 仍可进）或关闭。
- **为什么改**：只用一个身份提供方的企业，多一个登录页就是多一次点击和困惑；云端（C6）需要这个开关，自部署也能用。
- **风险与回滚**：默认关闭；不开时入口不挂载，`/auth/config` 只多一个 `directSignIn: false`；回滚只需关掉 `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_ENABLED`（或去掉 `directSignIn` 选项）。本地入口设为关闭时，登录页在任何情况下都不画密码表单；服务端密码登录接口不变，托管环境作废密码归 cloud#4471。
- **先看**：`direct-sign-in.ts`（回跳地址只留同源路径）和登录页的防循环判断 `directSignIn.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：配一个 OIDC 提供方，设 `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_ENABLED=true`，退出后打开任意 Console 页面，应直接跳到提供方，登录后回到该页面；在提供方点拒绝，应停在登录页并显示原因和重试按钮，不会反复跳转。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（先等新的评审代理做 TIER_DEFAULT 合约评审）。

## Ruling

Ruling 8 of cloud#4465 (the maintainer, 2026-11-13), as quoted on this issue in comment 6870716068:

> **Direct redirect to the identity provider is a platform feature, on by default in the cloud.**
> - The framework gains one setting: when SSO is configured, an unauthenticated visit skips the environment's sign-in page and goes straight to the configured identity provider, then returns to the original page.
> - The local sign-in path is configurable. Self-hosted can keep a hidden path (for example `/login?local=1`). Hosted has it off (ruling 10).
> - Self-hosted deployments with their own IdP can turn it on. Hosted environments have it on by default, with the cloud as the provider. The cloud sign-in page shows the organization's name and explains refusals (not a member under D5.1; invitation not accepted).

This PR is the framework half: the setting, the start door, the Console behaviour and the configurable local path. Turning it on by default for hosted environments, and the cloud sign-in page, are cloud#4471. Per D-2 (same comment), nothing here builds a recovery link or reopens the local path: with `localSignIn: 'off'` the page draws no local way in, in any state.

**Not changed here:** the server's `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email` still accepts a password whatever `localSignIn` says (`off` is the page's choice). Invalidating hosted passwords (ruling 10) belongs to cloud#4471.

## What changes

**Server (`@objectstack/plugin-auth`).** A new setting, `directSignIn` on the auth plugin, with environment overrides that win field by field: `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_ENABLED`, `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_PROVIDER`, `OS_AUTH_LOCAL_SIGN_IN` (`hidden` | `off`; any other value refuses to boot).

- While it is on, `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct?callbackURL=<path>` is mounted beside `/config`, before the auth wildcard, so a host forwarding `/api/v1/auth/*` gets it too. It picks the provider (the named one, or the one candidate across `oidcProviders` and `sys_sso_provider` rows), re-dispatches the vendor's own start (`/sign-in/social` for a generic-OAuth provider such as `objectstack-cloud`, `/sign-in/sso` for an SSO row) and answers 302 to the identity provider with the vendor's state cookie and `cache-control: no-store`. It mints nothing; the session is created by the vendor's callback as for any sign-in.
- The return path is kept only when it is a same-origin relative path at every percent-decoding layer (up to three): no `//`, no backslash, no control character, at most 2048 characters, and a URL parse that stays on the origin. It is composed onto the canonical origin. A foreign path is dropped and the sign-in returns to the Console root. `errorCallbackURL` is always the Console `/login`.
- The query takes `callbackURL` only, once; an unknown or repeated parameter is refused 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`. No provider, several providers, a named provider that is not configured, or a refused start redirects to `/login?error=direct_sign_in_unavailable` with one `warn` line naming the reason.
- `/auth/config` serves `features.directSignIn` always (`false` unless on, and `true` only while a provider can be started) and `features.localSignIn` while it is on.
- With the setting off the door is not mounted and every answer is as on `main`. `localSignIn: off` is the page's choice only: the password doors, `session.create.before` and `ssoOnlyMode` are untouched, so ADR-0135 D5.2 break-glass stays intact.

**Spec (`@objectstack/spec`).** `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` gains `directSignIn` (surface `login`, opt-in), so `requiresFeature` accepts the new value `requiresFeature: 'directSignIn'`. `localSignIn` joins the non-flag keys. `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` gains both members. Regenerated: `references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx`, `references/data/object.mdx`, `references/ui/action.mdx`, `authorable-surface/api.json`.

**Console (`@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`).** With `features.directSignIn` on, the sign-in page sends a signed-out visitor to the door, returning to the same `/login` URL marked `direct=returned`, so the page's post-sign-in steps (organization pick, OAuth and mobile hand-offs, safe `?redirect=`) run as after any sign-in. The loop guard keeps the page drawn, with the reason and a **Continue with single sign-on** button, on an `error`, and on a return without a session. An OAuth client's hand-off (`client_id` / `redirect_uri`) keeps today's page. `?local=1` draws today's page while the local path is `hidden` and is ignored while it is `off`. With `localSignIn: 'off'` the sign-in form (`@object-ui/auth` `LoginForm`) draws no local way in in any state that falls back to it: no email or phone form, no sign-up, no break-glass link, and no dev-admin row. That covers an OAuth client's hand-off and a deployment where no provider can start. Copy in all 11 locales.

**Docs.** A "Skip the sign-in page (direct sign-in)" section on the SSO page, and the three variables in the environment-variable reference.

## Tests

- `direct-sign-in.test.ts` (69): the setting and its env precedence; `keptReturnPath` over 22 foreign spellings (absolute, `//host`, `/\host`, `\\host`, `/%5cevil.example`, `/%2f%2f…`, double-encoded, an encoded scheme, `javascript:`, a tab or newline in the path, an encoded tab or newline, a broken escape, empty, over 2048 characters), each also through the door, where it returns to the Console root; the provider choice; the door with a fake host; the door mounted through `registerAuthRoutes` with the `objectstack-cloud` provider; both CONTROLs.
- `implicit-account-linking.test.ts` (+4 in a new describe): start → identity provider → callback over the real vendor, landing on the kept path with a session; a foreign return path lands on the Console root; an identity-provider error lands on `/_console/login?error=…`; a profile that cannot be read signs nobody in.
- `LoginPage.direct-sign-in.test.tsx` (16): the decision table, the start URL, and the page: CONTROL off, start, `?local=1` hidden vs off, the error hold with retry, the sessionless return, the OAuth hand-off, no local way in on the hand-off and on a refused start while the local path is off (with a CONTROL that `hidden` keeps the break-glass link), and the door's `direct_sign_in_unavailable` copy.
- Pins updated: the public feature count (14 → 15) and the served `/auth/config` fixture in `@objectstack/spec`; the exact `features` pin in `auth-manager.test.ts`; the auth route ledger's objectstack-mount pin and the `handleRequest` surface test (which now composes the door), with a reviewed `public` row for `GET /api/v1/auth/sign-in/direct`; `NOT_FOUND` registered under `@objectstack/plugin-auth` in the error-code ledger (the door's 404 when the setting is turned off after boot).

## Acceptance notes

Each pin was ablated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the mutation verified on disk, the restore verified against HEAD) and went red:

| Pin | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 round trip | the door ignores the kept path | 2 failed |
| 2 open redirect | drop the `//` check / the backslash check / the control-character check / the decode layers | 7 / 5 / 8 / 16 failed |
| 2 open redirect | keep any string as the return path | 51 failed |
| 2 open redirect | keep any string and drop the same-origin backstop on the composed URL | 52 failed |
| 3 local hidden vs off | honour `?local=1` while off | 2 failed |
| 4 no loop | do not hold on `error` / on `direct=returned` | 2 / 2 failed |
| 5 CONTROL off | mount the door with the setting off / start on the page without the flag | 52 / 3 failed |
| 6 CONTROL api, mcp, bearer | the door claims every GET | 1 failed |
| 7 local off on the form | `LoginForm` ignores `localSignIn: 'off'` | 2 failed |

One layer did not go red alone: the URL-parse origin check inside `keptReturnPath`. It is a backstop by construction. A path that passes the `//`, backslash and control-character checks at every decode layer resolves on the origin, so no input reaches that check alone. It is kept as a second check.

Open-redirect cases covered, each dropped and never followed: absolute (`https://evil.example/x`, `http://evil.example`), protocol-relative (`//evil.example`), backslash (`/\evil.example`, `\\evil.example`, `/%5cevil.example`, `/%5Cevil.example`), encoded slashes (`/%2f%2f…`, double-encoded `/%252f%252f…`), an encoded scheme (`https%3A%2F%2Fevil.example`), `javascript:`, a tab or newline in the path (raw and encoded), a broken escape, empty and over-long values.

Both CONTROLs hold: with the setting off the door is not mounted and `/auth/config` differs only by `directSignIn: false`; with it on, `/api/*`, `/mcp`, API-key and bearer requests are never redirected.

## Verification

On head `f690739f`, after merging `origin/main` once and rebuilding the packages:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 123 derived families, each run with `</dev/null` and its exit code recorded; `--ran` reconciles **123 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, every one exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` full suite: 269 files, 5184 passed, 10 skipped.
- `@objectstack/spec`: full suite earlier in the card (839 files, 26834 tests); `src/api` after the ledger change (63 files, 2063 tests).
- `@objectstack/client` route-ledger consumers (3 files, 12 tests).
- `ui`: `packages/auth` (45 files, 468 tests) and `LoginPage.direct-sign-in.test.tsx` (16).

The first gate pass found three failures, all fixed in this branch. `check:auth-mount-ledger` wanted a literal mount path and a ledger row. `check:error-code-provenance` wanted the `NOT_FOUND` row. `check:generated` hit a heap out-of-memory in `check:test-typecheck`, which is green with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`.
